pr.description:
Unified PR lifecycle CLI — CI failures, code review, and review comments

When to use: Managing PR lifecycle: checking CI status, running reviews, addressing comments, or viewing unified PR status

Usage: pr status  |  pr ci [--fix]  |  pr review [--self] [--fix] [--post] [--repair] [--summary] [--recover]  |  pr review --list [--schema-version N]  |  pr comments [--triage] [--fix] [--finish] [--post]  |  pr comments --settle <id> [--as fixed|dismissed|already_addressed] [--reason <text>] [--commit <sha>]  |  pr fix  |  pr rebase [--fix] [--no-push] [--force] [--abort] [--onto <ref>]  |  pr gc
pr.name: pr
